correctness.rationale: Writing n=(p+1)/2 and g=n-1, the coefficient of x^{pi-j} in F(x)^g is nonzero only if j=n-i; the antidiagonal entry is b_{2i-1}(a). Reciprocal b_j=b_{2g-j} makes opposite antidiagonal entries equal, so the Frobenius-twisted square is diagonal with nonzero support exactly the Cartier support, proving stable rank=p-rank. Odd coefficients vanish at a=0; b1=b_{2g-1}=ga gives at least two nonzero entries for every a!=0. Each odd coefficient has a nonzero leading a-coefficient, so generic ordinary; parity from fixed-point-free pairing if g even. Verified original F squarefree precisely a²!=4 and genus g. Independent exact modular coefficient and stable-rank checks on smooth F_p parameters at p=11,13,17,19,23,29, not proof for all p.

originality.rationale: Borges–Gonçalves treat two-term Fermat type y^m=x^n+1, including the undeformed a=0 curve, not the entire parameter a pencil. Kudo–Nakagawa–Takagi treat fixed genus-four cyclic-six hyperelliptic models, different from all-prime-linked genus g. Resultary search on exact family and equivalent Cartier-dihedral polynomial formulas located no prior full all-prime stable-rank statement. Nevertheless classical dihedral Hasse–Witt literature may encode it, recorded as a specific risk.
